name: Simplified LV5FU2

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic fluorouracil/leucovorin backbone is not biomarker-restricted. RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested (broad multigene NGS panel also picks up POLE/POLD1, RET, NTRK) to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons, not the backbone itself: anti-EGFR (cetuximab or panitumumab) requires KRAS/NRAS/BRAF wild-type with a left-sided primary; HER2-directed therapy for HER2 amplified; checkpoint inhibitors for dMMR/MSI-H; encorafenib for BRAF V600E. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN, licensed), Colon Cancer Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B) and Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D).

lineOfTherapy: any line of therapy in metastatic disease, as a less intensive fluorouracil/leucovorin option, if not previously given

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.11 footnote

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123486-123487: LV 400 mg/m2 over 2 hr. Not on the NCCN tall man lettering list (appendix G).

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123486-123487: followed by bolus 5-FU 400 mg/m2. Not on the NCCN tall man lettering list (appendix G).

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (infusion)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123486-123487: followed by 5-FU 1,200 mg/m2/d times 2 d (2,400 mg/m2 over 46-48 hr). Printed as a per-day rate given continuously across days 1-2; not a range, no alternate value to note.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: low emetic risk tier per NCCN Antiemesis / appendix D framework (IV 5-fluorouracil bolus and infusion regimens fall in the low, 10-30 percent, emetic-risk category); PRN antiemetic per NCCN Antiemesis guideline
G-CSF: not a high or intermediate febrile-neutropenia risk regimen per appendix C framework; prophylactic CSF not routinely indicated, physician discretion based on patient-specific risk factors

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

guideline.locator: Colon Cancer, Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D; Fluorouracil/Leucovorin as a less intensive option for any line of therapy, if not previously given); Principles of Adjuvant Therapy and Chemotherapy Regimens (COL-G; Simplified biweekly infusional Fluorouracil/Leucovorin, sLV5FU2); Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B)

divergence.note: DeVita lists Simplified LV5FU2 (Table 40.11) under management of unresectable metastatic disease. The guideline additionally lists Simplified biweekly infusional Fluorouracil/Leucovorin (sLV5FU2) as an adjuvant chemotherapy regimen (COL-G) and Fluorouracil/Leucovorin as a less intensive option for any line in metastatic disease (COL-D). Physician-facing treatmentSetting kept conservative (metastatic); adjuvant use left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: Earlier VERIFY-resolution (DeVita core): DeVita 12th ed. lists Simplified LV5FU2 (Table 40.11) within the section on management of unresectable metastatic disease (header line 123342; unresectable stage IV disease, lines 123351 and 123359), which is explicitly palliative. histology resolved to adenocarcinoma (Chapter 40, line 121516 colorectal adenocarcinoma; Histologic Type section line 121080). treatmentSetting resolved to metastatic and stage to IV from that section. eligibilityCriteria resolved to good performance status with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function per Table 40.11 footnote (line 123493) and the metastatic-disease entry-criteria preamble (lines 123415 to 123420). ONCQIS Wave-1 batch 1 guideline resolution (Standard Guidelines, NCCN licensed, Colon Cancer v2.2026): lineOfTherapy resolved to any line of therapy in metastatic disease as a less intensive fluorouracil/leucovorin option, if not previously given (COL-D less intensive therapy). biomarkers resolved: the cytotoxic fluorouracil/leucovorin backbone is not biomarker-restricted, while RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons (COL-B and COL-D). A divergence is recorded on treatmentSetting: the guideline additionally lists sLV5FU2 as an adjuvant chemotherapy regimen (COL-G), whereas the DeVita core places it in the metastatic setting; the physician-facing value is kept conservative (metastatic).
